brief_detail: A north-facing balcony behind a tall building, so it never sees direct sun. I want it to look lush anyway and my cat spends all day there.
A west-facing balcony with soft afternoon light filtered through a neighbouring tree. My indoor cat loves to sit among the pots.
A south-facing balcony in summer gets brutal sun all day and the wind dries the soil quickly. One elderly cat, indoor, but I also worry about a stray.
A small apartment balcony with a dripping air-conditioner that keeps the soil constantly wet. My beagle digs in every pot.
A ground-floor courtyard that gets full sun from midday. Two large dogs run through it daily and rub against the planters.
A walled courtyard with no direct sunlight at all and rain-shadow walls that keep it dry. Nobody lives here, it is just for the view.
An east-facing balcony with no direct sun but very bright open shade, and a cat who chews absolutely everything.
A rooftop terrace with full sun and a shared rain barrel that keeps the soil wet. No pets, I just want a lush look.
A shaded inner courtyard with very free-draining soil and a husky that digs up every root.
A damp north-facing balcony under dripping pipes, with a cat who loves to sit in the wet soil.
A sunny balcony and one cat. I would like some cat grass for her to nibble on.
A half-shady balcony with a small dog who likes to nibble at plants.
A bright but sunless courtyard with fast-draining gravel pots, purely decorative.
A hot south balcony with dry soil and a dog who digs and chews.
A shaded balcony with a rain barrel keeping the soil soggy, and a cat who is fascinated by anything green.
A fully shaded courtyard with a cat that spends hours in it.
A bright shaded balcony with wet soil and a dog who chews plants.
A sunny balcony, no pets, I want a sensory planting with fragrant herbs.
A courtyard with dappled light and moderate soil moisture, no pets, mainly visual interest.
A pitch-black north balcony with dry wind-blown soil and a cat who sits in the corner all day.
A sunny balcony kept wet by a drip hose, with one cat.
A shaded courtyard where a large dog likes to rub against tall plants.
A half-shady balcony with dry soil and no pets, low maintenance only.
A bright shaded balcony with a cat, and I want trailing plants to soften the railing.
A hot, dry, sun-baked courtyard with a dog who digs and rubs against everything.
